g.text: Frame virtual work combines real and unit-load bending diagrams to find lateral displacement

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal fixed-base portal with infinitely rigid horizontal beam, axially inextensible columns, height3 m,span4 m,each column EI=20000 kN·m². Rigid beam enforces equal
sway and zero top rotations; each column carries half lateral P. Diagrams show column bending only; beam energy tends zero as beam EI→∞. Unit coefficients are moment
per unit lateral force. Finite-beam/axial/shear flexibility changes the result.
